newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX raises Henry Hub natural gas spread margins.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX raises Henry Hub natural gas spread margins.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said it has raised the margins it collects on spreads involving the second month of the Henry Hub natural gas futures contract to match margins for the spot month.
The higher second-month spread margins took effect from the close of business Monday, January 6, NYMEX said in a statement.
According to the exchange, the new rates are set at $3,800 for clearing members, $4,180 for exchange members, and $5,130 for customers.
Previously, the rates for the spreads involving the second month were $500 for clearing members, $550 for members, and $675 for customers.
